references.text: Joseph's repeated comfort 'do not be afraid' shows the continuity of his role as savior to his brothers, from fear to security.
The fulfillment of Jacob's fear of losing his sons (Gen 42:36) and Joseph removing this fear by returning Simeon (Gen 43:23).
The direct narrative connection between Joseph taking Simeon (Gen 42:24) and later releasing him to show God's grace (Gen 43:23).
